vsm1.1:43.1: Tatrāyaṃ ādito paṭṭhāya anupubbapadavaṇṇanāya saddhiṃ vinicchayakathā.
vsm1.1:43.3: Bhikkhūti saṃsāre bhayaṃ ikkhaṇatāya vā bhinnapaṭadharāditāya vā evaṃ laddhavohāro saddhāpabbajito kulaputto.
vsm1.1:43.5: Tañhi yo naṃ pāti rakkhati, taṃ mokkheti mocayati āpāyikādīhi dukkhehi,
vsm1.1:44.4: Tattha katamo anācāro? Kāyiko vītikkamo vācasiko vītikkamo kāyikavācasiko vītikkamo,
vsm1.1:44.7: Idhekacco veḷudānena vā pattadānena vā pupphaphalasinānadantakaṭṭhadānena vā cāṭukamyatāya vā
vsm1.1:44.8: muggasūpyatāya vā pāribhaṭyatāya vā jaṅghapesanikena vā
vsm1.1:44.9: aññataraññatarena vā buddhapaṭikuṭṭhena micchāājīvena jīvikaṃ kappeti, ayaṃ vuccati anācāro.
vsm1.1:44.10: Tattha katamo ācāro? Kāyiko avītikkamo vācasiko avītikkamo kāyikavācasiko avītikkamo,
vsm1.1:44.13: Idhekacco na veḷudānena vā na pattana pupphana phalana sinānana dantakaṭṭhadānena vā na cāṭukamyatāya vā
vsm1.1:44.14: na muggasūpyatāya vā na pāribhaṭyatāya vā na jaṅghapesanikena vā
vsm1.1:44.15: na aññataraññatarena vā buddhapaṭikuṭṭhena micchāājīvena jīvikaṃ kappeti, ayaṃ vuccati ācāro.
vsm1.1:45.2: Tattha katamo agocaro? Idhekacco vesiyāgocaro vā hoti vidhavā, thullakumārikā, paṇḍaka, bhikkhunī, pānāgāragocaro vā hoti,
vsm1.1:45.3: saṃsaṭṭho viharati rājūhi rājamahāmattehi titthiyehi titthiyasāvakehi ananulomikena saṃsaggena,
vsm1.1:45.4: yāni vā pana tāni kulāni assaddhāni appasannāni anopānabhūtāni akkosakaparibhāsakāni anatthakāmāni ahitakāmāni aphāsukakāmāni ayogakkhemakāmāni bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānaṃ, tathārūpāni kulāni sevati bhajati payirupāsati, ayaṃ vuccati agocaro.
vsm1.1:45.5: Tattha katamo gocaro? Idhekacco na vesiyāgocaro vā hoti…pe… na pānāgāragocaro vā hoti,
vsm1.1:45.6: asaṃsaṭṭho viharati rājūhi…pe… titthiyasāvakehi ananulomikena saṃsaggena,
vsm1.1:45.7: yāni vā pana tāni kulāni saddhāni pasannāni opānabhūtāni kāsāvapajjotāni isivātapaṭivātāni atthakāmāni…pe… yogakkhemakāmāni bhikkhūnaṃ…pe… upāsikānaṃ, tathārūpāni kulāni sevati bhajati payirupāsati, ayaṃ vuccati gocaro.
vsm1.1:45.8: Iti iminā ca ācārena iminā ca gocarena upeto hoti samupeto upagato samupagato upapanno sampanno samannāgato,
vsm1.1:46.1: Api cettha imināpi nayena ācāragocarā veditabbā.
vsm1.1:46.2: Duvidho hi anācāro kāyiko vācasiko ca.
vsm1.1:46.4: Idhekacco saṅghagatopi acittīkārakato there bhikkhū ghaṭṭayantopi tiṭṭhati, ghaṭṭayantopi nisīdati, puratopi tiṭṭhati, puratopi nisīdati, uccepi āsane nisīdati, sasīsampi pārupitvā nisīdati, ṭhitakopi bhaṇati, bāhāvikkhepakopi bhaṇati,
vsm1.1:46.5: therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anupāhanānaṃ caṅkamantānaṃ saupāhano caṅkamati, nīce caṅkame caṅkamantānaṃ ucce caṅkame caṅkamati, chamāya caṅkamantānaṃ caṅkame caṅkamati,
vsm1.1:46.6: there bhikkhū anupakhajjāpi tiṭṭhati, anupakhajjāpi nisīdati, navepi bhikkhū āsanena paṭibāhati,
vsm1.1:46.7: jantāgharepi there bhikkhū anāpucchā kaṭṭhaṃ pakkhipati, dvāraṃ pidahati,
vsm1.1:46.8: udakatitthepi there bhikkhū ghaṭṭayantopi otarati, puratopi otarati, ghaṭṭayantopi nhāyati, puratopi nhāyati, ghaṭṭayantopi uttarati, puratopi uttarati,
vsm1.1:46.9: antaragharaṃ pavisantopi there bhikkhū ghaṭṭayantopi gacchati, puratopi gacchati, vokkamma ca therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ purato purato gacchati,
vsm1.1:46.10: yānipi tāni honti kulānaṃ ovarakāni gūḷhāni ca paṭicchannāni ca yattha kulitthiyo kulakumāriyo nisīdanti, tatthapi sahasā pavisati, kumārakassapi sīsaṃ parāmasati, ayaṃ vuccati kāyiko anācāro.
vsm1.1:47.2: Idhekacco saṅghagatopi acittīkārakato there bhikkhū anāpucchā dhammaṃ bhaṇati. Pañhaṃ vissajjeti, pātimokkhaṃ uddisati, ṭhitakopi bhaṇati, bāhāvikkhepakopi bhaṇati,
vsm1.1:47.3: antaragharaṃ paviṭṭhopi itthiṃ vā kumāriṃ vā evamāha – ‘‘itthannāme itthaṃgotte kiṃ atthi,
vsm1.1:47.4: yāgu atthi, bhattaṃ atthi, khādanīyaṃ atthi, kiṃ pivissāma, kiṃ khādissāma, kiṃ bhuñjissāma.
vsm1.1:47.5: Kiṃ vā me dassathā’’ti vippalapati, ayaṃ vuccati vācasiko anācāro (mahāni. 87).
vsm1.1:48.2: Apica bhikkhu sagāravo sappatisso hirottappasampanno sunivattho supāruto
vsm1.1:48.3: pāsādikena abhikkantena paṭikkantena ālokitena vilokitena samiñjitena pasāritena okkhittacakkhu iriyāpathasampanno
vsm1.1:48.4: indriyesu guttadvāro bhojane mattaññū jāgariyamanuyutto satisampajaññena samannāgato appiccho santuṭṭho āraddhavīriyo ābhisamācārikesu sakkaccakārī garucittīkārabahulo viharati, ayaṃ vuccati ācāro.
vsm1.1:49.1: Gocaro pana tividho upanissayagocaro ārakkhagocaro upanibandhagocaroti.
vsm1.1:49.3: yaṃ nissāya assutaṃ suṇāti, sutaṃ pariyodapeti, kaṅkhaṃ vitarati, diṭṭhiṃ ujuṃ karoti, cittaṃ pasādeti.
vsm1.1:49.4: Yassa vā pana anusikkhamāno saddhāya vaḍḍhati, sīlena, sutena, cāgena, paññāya vaḍḍhati,
vsm1.1:50.1: Katamo ārakkhagocaro? Idha bhikkhu antaragharaṃ paviṭṭho vīthiṃ paṭipanno okkhittacakkhu yugamattadassāvī susaṃvuto gacchati,
vsm1.1:50.2: na hatthiṃ olokento, na assaṃ, na rathaṃ, na pattiṃ, na itthiṃ, na purisaṃ olokento,
vsm1.1:50.3: na uddhaṃ ullokento, na adho olokento, na disāvidisaṃ pekkhamāno gacchati, ayaṃ vuccati ārakkhagocaro.
vsm1.1:51.1: Katamo upanibandhagocaro? Cattāro satipaṭṭhānā yattha cittaṃ upanibandhati.
vsm1.1:51.2: Vuttañhetaṃ bhagavatā – ‘‘ko ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno gocaro sako pettiko visayo? Yadidaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā’’ti (saṃ. ni. 5.372),
vsm1.1:51.4: Iti iminā ca ācārena iminā ca gocarena upeto…pe… samannāgato.
vsm1.1:52.4: yaṃkiñci sikkhāpadesu sikkhitabbaṃ, taṃ sabbaṃ sammā ādāya sikkhati.
vsm1.1:52.8: sabbaṃ yathāpaṭipannassa taṃ sīlaṃ sampajjati, taṃ paṭipattiṃ dassetuṃ vuttanti veditabbaṃ.
vsm1.1:53.1: Yaṃ panetaṃ tadanantaraṃ ‘‘so cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā’’tiādinā nayena dassitaṃ indriyasaṃvarasīlaṃ,
vsm1.1:53.4: kāraṇavasena cakkhūti laddhavohārena rūpadassanasamatthena cakkhuviññāṇena rūpaṃ disvā.
vsm1.1:53.5: Porāṇā panāhu ‘‘cakkhu rūpaṃ na passati, acittakattā, cittaṃ na passati, acakkhukattā,
vsm1.1:53.6: dvārārammaṇasaṅghaṭṭe pana cakkhupasādavatthukena cittena passati. Īdisī panesā ‘dhanunā vijjhatī’tiādīsu viya sasambhārakathā nāma hoti,
vsm1.1:53.7: tasmā cakkhuviññāṇena rūpaṃ disvāti ayamevettha attho’’ti.
vsm1.1:54.1: Na nimittaggāhīti itthipurisanimittaṃ vā subhanimittādikaṃ vā kilesavatthubhūtaṃ nimittaṃ na gaṇhāti,
vsm1.1:54.4: kilesānaṃ anuanubyañjanato pākaṭabhāvakaraṇato anubyañjananti laddhavohāraṃ hatthapādasitahasitakathitavilokitādibhedaṃ ākāraṃ na gaṇhāti,
vsm1.1:55.1: Theraṃ kira cetiyapabbatā anurādhapuraṃ piṇḍacāratthāya āgacchantaṃ
vsm1.1:55.2: aññatarā kulasuṇhā sāmikena saddhiṃ bhaṇḍitvā sumaṇḍitapasādhitā devakaññā viya kālasseva anurādhapurato nikkhamitvā ñātigharaṃ gacchantī antarāmagge disvā vipallatthacittā mahāhasitaṃ hasi.
vsm1.1:55.4: tassā dantaṭṭhike asubhasaññaṃ paṭilabhitvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇi.
vsm1.1:55.5: Tena vuttaṃ – ‘‘Tassā dantaṭṭhikaṃ disvā, pubbasaññaṃ anussari; Tattheva so ṭhito thero, arahattaṃ apāpuṇī’’ti.
vsm1.1:55.6: Sāmikopi kho panassā anumaggaṃ gacchanto theraṃ disvā ‘‘kiñci, bhante, itthiṃ passathā’’ti pucchi.
vsm1.1:55.7: Taṃ thero āha – ‘‘Nābhijānāmi itthī vā, puriso vā ito gato; Apica aṭṭhisaṅghāṭo, gacchatesa mahāpathe’’ti.
vsm1.1:56.2: yaṃkāraṇā yassa cakkhundriyāsaṃvarassa hetu etaṃ puggalaṃ satikavāṭena cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ apihitacakkhudvāraṃ hutvā viharantaṃ
vsm1.1:56.4: Tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjatīti tassa cakkhundriyassa satikavāṭena pidahanatthāya paṭipajjati.
vsm1.1:56.5: Evaṃ paṭipajjantoyeva ca rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjatītipi vuccati.
vsm1.1:57.1: Tattha kiñcāpi cakkhundriye saṃvaro vā asaṃvaro vā natthi.
vsm1.1:57.2: Na hi cakkhupasādaṃ nissāya sati vā muṭṭhasaccaṃ vā uppajjati.
vsm1.1:57.3: Apica yadā rūpārammaṇaṃ cakkhussa āpāthaṃ āgacchati,
vsm1.1:57.4: tadā bhavaṅge dvikkhattuṃ uppajjitvā niruddhe kiriyamanodhātu āvajjanakiccaṃ sādhayamānā uppajjitvā nirujjhati.
vsm1.1:57.5: Tato cakkhuviññāṇaṃ dassanakiccaṃ. Tato vipākamanodhātu sampaṭicchanakiccaṃ.
vsm1.1:57.6: Tato vipākāhetukamanoviññāṇadhātu santīraṇakiccaṃ. Tato kiriyāhetukamanoviññāṇadhātu voṭṭhabbanakiccaṃ sādhayamānā uppajjitvā nirujjhati,
vsm1.1:57.9: na āvajjanādīnaṃ aññatarasamaye saṃvaro vā asaṃvaro vā atthi.
vsm1.1:57.10: Javanakkhaṇe pana sace dussīlyaṃ vā muṭṭhasaccaṃ vā aññāṇaṃ vā akkhanti vā kosajjaṃ vā uppajjati, asaṃvaro hoti.
vsm1.1:57.11: Evaṃ honto pana so cakkhundriye asaṃvaroti vuccati.
vsm1.1:58.2: Yasmā tasmiṃ sati dvārampi aguttaṃ hoti, bhavaṅgampi āvajjanādīnipi vīthicittāni.
vsm1.1:58.4: Yathā nagare catūsu dvāresu asaṃvutesu kiñcāpi antogharadvārakoṭṭhakagabbhādayo susaṃvutā honti,
vsm1.1:58.5: tathāpi antonagare sabbaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ arakkhitaṃ agopitameva hoti.
vsm1.1:58.6: Nagaradvārena hi pavisitvā corā yadicchanti, taṃ kareyyuṃ,
vsm1.1:58.7: evameva javane dussīlyādīsu uppannesu tasmiṃ asaṃvare sati dvārampi aguttaṃ hoti, bhavaṅgampi āvajjanādīnipi vīthicittāni.
vsm1.1:58.8: Tasmiṃ pana sīlādīsu uppannesu dvārampi guttaṃ hoti,
vsm1.1:58.11: Yathā nagaradvāresu saṃvutesu kiñcāpi antogharādayo asaṃvutā honti,
vsm1.1:58.12: tathāpi antonagare sabbaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ surakkhitaṃ sugopitameva hoti.
vsm1.1:58.13: Nagaradvāresu hi pihitesu corānaṃ paveso natthi,
vsm1.1:58.14: evameva javane sīlādīsu uppannesu dvārampi guttaṃ hoti, bhavaṅgampi āvajjanādīnipi vīthicittāni.
vsm1.1:58.15: Tasmā javanakkhaṇe uppajjamānopi cakkhundriye saṃvaroti vutto.
